requirements.name: Settling time
requirements.reason: Candidate settling time must remain within 120 percent of the current controller.

requirements.name: Overshoot
requirements.reason: Peak response must remain within the declared overshoot limit.

requirements.name: Steady-state error
requirements.reason: Final absolute error must be at most two percent of the test amplitude.

requirements.name: MV excursion
requirements.reason: Controller output excursion must remain inside the configured output span.

requirements.name: MV rate
requirements.reason: Controller output rate must remain inside the configured rate limits.

requirements.name: Saturation recovery
requirements.reason: The response must recover from saturation within one quarter of the validation horizon.

requirements.name: Noise response
requirements.reason: Candidate noise-driven output activity must remain within 120 percent of the current controller or 0.1 percent of the configured output span, whichever limit is larger.

requirements.name: Gain margin
requirements.reason: Gain margin must be at least 6 dB.

requirements.name: Phase margin
requirements.reason: Phase margin must be at least 30 degrees.

requirements.name: Bounded variation stability
requirements.reason: Every declared bounded model variation must remain finite and bounded.
